verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EWALA mu ggulu
Bamalayika be
Bayimba n'essanyu
Nga batendereza-
Aleruuya!
Basanyuka okuyimba
Aleruuya!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Era mu nsi muno
Katonda-akkiriza
Ennyimba z'abato
Bonna-abamwagala.
Aleruuya!
Naffe ka tumuyimbire,
Aleruuya!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu Mulokozi,
Tukwegayiridde
Otuyingirize
Amazima gonna.
Aleruuya!
Tulyoke tukuyimbire,
Aleruuya!

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Bunya-ekigambo kyo;
Buli ggwanga-ery'ensi
Likyukire gy'oli.
Aleruuya!
-Ebika byonna biriyimba,
Aleruuya!
